item.title: They Dedicated Their Lives to Teaching. Then the Deepfakes Started
item.description: The deepfake epidemic in schools is affecting more than students. Four teachers tell WIRED about becoming targets of sexualized, AI-generated content—and how difficult it was to find accountability.

item.title: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
item.description: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.

item.title: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
item.description: The UK government is facing calls to cancel a sprawling health care contract with Palantir. The region of Greater Manchester insists it can do a better job itself.

item.title: Silicon Valley Doesn't Get Why You Hate AI
item.description: Technology leaders don’t seem to understand society’s gripes about AI, but boy, are they posting through it.

item.title: I Saw the Future of AI in a Robot That Can Learn on the Spot
item.description: During a recent visit to Generalist AI, I watched a robotic arm improvise and use a banana as a tool.

item.title: Coders Say They Already Found Workarounds to Claude’s Invisible Watermarks
item.description: Anthropic announced last week it would include invisible watermarks in AI-generated content to comply with new EU rules. Within hours, overrides were being touted online.

item.title: Flock Has a Powerful New AI Tool for Police. We Got Its Code
item.description: Flock’s surveillance cameras have already sparked outrage. WIRED reconstructed its next-generation AI system, already in use by some police, to confirm it goes much further than tracking license plates.

item.title: OpenAI Overhauls Safety Protocols After Its AI Agents Went Rogue
item.description: The ChatGPT maker says its upcoming Astra model may have reached “critical” cyber capabilities, prompting it to halt a significant number of training runs while it tightens internal safeguards.

item.title: The Powerful Chinese AI Model Experts Warned About Is Here
item.description: Z.ai’s latest AI model release could help companies secure their systems—or find its way into the hands of hackers.

item.title: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
item.description: When Twitch announced that streamers could opt out, thousands of users questioned why their content was being used to train AI models in the first place.
